lhs_design: one global N-point LatinHypercube design per size/repetition; decoded collisions discard the entire design and trigger a deterministic complete-design retry; blocks are never concatenated

distribution_diagnostics.pairwise_precedence: estimated from a deterministic subset of at most 512 permutations
distribution_diagnostics.kendall_distance: distance to the first permutation in the diagnostic subset
distribution_diagnostics.permutation_hash: SHA-256 of contiguous int32 permutation matrix

test_design: fixed independent uniform permutations per instance, shared across all training sizes and repetitions

training_design.lhs_random_keys: one global N-point LHS design for each size and repetition; stable argsort decoder; complete-design retries on decoded duplicates
training_design.uniform_permutations: one maximum-size uniform permutation set per repetition; smaller sizes are nested prefixes

model: scripts.run_week4_surrogate.build_model; MLP 64x64 with feature and target scaling
literature_basis: Framinan (2025), DOI 10.1049/cim2.70049: PFSP stochastic, GBT, sample sizes 10/100/1000
Muñoz and Kirley (2021), DOI 10.3390/a14010019: logarithmically spaced sample sizes and LHS
